# AltivonGlobal

> AltivonGlobal connects business buyers with Indian-origin moringa leaf powder, beetroot powder and ashwagandha powder. Based in Vadodara, Gujarat, India, the business coordinates sourcing, packaging discussions, product documentation and export enquiries.

Product details below are catalogue information. Final grade, plant part, availability, specification, documents, packing and shipment terms must be confirmed for the proposed order. Imagery is illustrative. The website does not provide medical advice or claim that every product is approved for every destination.

## Products

- [Product collection](https://altivonglobal.com/products): Overview of the three current powders.
- [Moringa leaf powder](https://altivonglobal.com/products/moringa-leaf-powder): Indian-origin leaf powder; catalogue lists 60 or 80 mesh, subject to grade confirmation.
- [Beetroot powder](https://altivonglobal.com/products/beetroot-powder): Dried beetroot powder for food mixes, beverage blends, bakery and culinary formulations, subject to the approved grade and applicable rules.
- [Ashwagandha powder](https://altivonglobal.com/products/ashwagandha-powder): Botanical powder for buyer-defined herbal ingredient applications; confirm the exact plant part and specification.

## Sourcing and export

Catalogue MOQ: 500 kg. Standard bulk packs: 25 kg and 50 kg. Custom packaging and private label: on request, subject to confirmation. Company monthly supply capacity: 20–25 MT, subject to product availability and scheduling; confirm capacity for the chosen product. FOB, CIF or EXW terms, named place/port, payment terms and lead time are agreed in the quotation. A catalogue or a listed document is not a batch-specific test report or proof of certification.

- [Bulk supply and packaging](https://altivonglobal.com/bulk-supply): Pack formats, private label and order planning.
- [Quality and documentation](https://altivonglobal.com/quality-documentation): Specifications, batch COAs and relevant supporting reports.
- [Export planning](https://altivonglobal.com/global-markets): Destination, intended-use, documentation and shipment considerations.
- [Request a quotation, sample or documents](https://altivonglobal.com/request-quote): Select the product and send your buying brief.
- [About AltivonGlobal](https://altivonglobal.com/about): Company focus and business contact.
- [Contact](https://altivonglobal.com/contact): inquiry@altivonglobal.com; +91 96622 43324; Vadodara, Gujarat, India.
